what: On hover the text scrambles into runes (ᚠᚢᚦ…), then from 80ms to 700ms it locks one letter at a time from the front into another word (to). Scrambled letters change every two frames and glow faintly. The whole link is pulled toward the cursor by .35 of its distance from the center over 80ms ease-out. On leave it locks back to the original word the same way and springs back into place over .45s cubic-bezier(.2,1,.3,1). The letter cell width is fixed at .72em.

options.to: Word that locks in on hover, if empty it reshuffles into the same word
options.lead: When the first letter locks in (ms), default 80
options.magnet: Pull share, default .35 — 0 means no pull
options.chars: Character set to shuffle, default 24 runes (ᚠᚢᚦᚨᚱᚲᚷᚹᚺᚾᛁᛃᛇᛈᛉᛊᛏᛒᛖᛗᛚᛜᛞᛟ) — if the font does not show runes, also load Noto Sans Runic
options.--fx-cell: Character cell width, default .72em — 0 keeps the font’s own width

from.where: index.html center vertical menu (.cs-menu__link) — original ScrambleLink(scrambleMs 700 · magnetStrength .35 · hoverText) + MainMenu

note: Text that only scrambles and does not get pulled is the text-scramble Motion part. On touch devices (no hover) nothing is attached
